preference.scoreDefinition: For each assigned slot: verified purchase ? met preference checks / specified preference checks : 0; slots with no specified preferences score 0. Unknown checks remain in the fraction denominator; no-preference counts are disclosed.

allServerConfirmedOrders.scope: Server-confirmed quantity-one orders, including confirmed orders excluded from valid-purchase scoring; revenue is merchandise subtotal only. Hidden shipping remains unknown, never an observed zero charge.

allServerConfirmedOrders.scope: Server-confirmed quantity-one orders, including confirmed orders excluded from valid-purchase scoring; revenue is merchandise subtotal only. Hidden shipping remains unknown, never an observed zero charge.

limitations: Synthetic fixed scenario panel, not human conversion lift or independent identically distributed customers.

Descriptive Wilson intervals and a paired case bootstrap show finite-panel uncertainty; they do not establish population effects, causal lift, or generalization. Small samples can produce degenerate bootstrap intervals.
Every assigned slot remains in conversion and revenue denominators; nonpurchases, missing slots, invalid evidence, interruptions and timeouts contribute zero revenue.

Purchases require validated aggregate gold/constraint/catalog checks plus verified independent-DOM fake checkout, formal protocol and budget. This analyzer consumes those recorded checks; it does not rehash artifacts or independently rescore gold/catalog.
Preference credits count only verified purchases. Unobserved checks are not fabricated, unknown checks do not earn credit, and no-preference cases are reported separately.
Comparable elapsed times require measured monotonic total runtime and a known start. Estimated, upper-bound and missing timings are excluded; partial observed step counts remain separately visible.
Browser readiness is a verified after-paint opportunity measure, not physical paint, image transfer, native GPU latency or end-to-end shopper latency.
metrics.primaryOutcome: Intent-correct success: verified valid fake checkout or independently justified and evidenced abstention
metrics.checkoutEvidencePolicy: Server-confirmed fake order and visible checkout confirmation plus independent-DOM, catalog/gold, constraints, protocol and budget gates; receipt artifacts hashed and GET readback verified. All-server revenue retains accepted orders even when UI confirmation fails.

definitions.effort: Recorded fully timed steps and measured monotonic elapsed only; exclusions retained.
definitions.latency: Browser after-paint opportunity; not physical paint, image transfer or native GPU latency.
definitions.primary: Intent-correct success includes verified valid checkout or justified abstention.
definitions.revenue: USD merchandise cents per assigned session; nonpurchase slots contribute zero valid revenue. All-server revenue also retains UI-failed accepted orders.
definitions.preference: Independent preference-match proxy on purchased products; not observed customer satisfaction.
definitions.sensitivity: Prespecified first5 pilot versus remaining55; descriptive subsets, original case clusters, no controls pooled.
definitions.uncertainty: Wilson95 full-panel rates; seeded20000 paired-case bootstrap, local minus generic. winsLossesTies=[local wins,generic wins,ties]. Small repeated-catalog panel, not IID customers or human lift.
